target_change: Move from waiting for a named method to independently recognizing the redox structure, choosing a representation and committing to a first move.

stages.prompt: What information in the reaction can distinguish which species changed?
Choose one representation that would make the change visible before doing any role naming.
Write only the first move you would execute and justify why it is legal.
What independent condition would falsify your final role assignment?

stage_selection_reason: This problem family is difficult mainly because method selection and representation are hidden; the dialogue therefore withholds solution execution until the learner commits to those structural choices.

misconception_branches.learner_self_identification_cue: I named the agent from a memorized word pair without checking species change.
misconception_branches.corrective_prompt: Return to the chosen representation and state SELF change before OTHER effect.
